mapper.select: INSERT INTO derive_plan_snapshot ( run_id, revision, contract_version, contract_hash, status, plan_hash, graph, admission_report ) VALUES ( #{p.runId}, #{p.revision}, #{p.contractVersion}, #{p.contractHash}, #{p.status}, #{p.planHash}, #{p.graph}::jsonb, #{p.admissionReport}::jsonb ) RETURNING id

SELECT id, run_id, revision, contract_version, contract_hash, status, plan_hash, graph::text AS graph, admission_report::text AS admission_report, created_time, updated_time, created_user_id, updated_user_id FROM derive_plan_snapshot WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, run_id, revision, contract_version, contract_hash, status, plan_hash, graph::text AS graph, admission_report::text AS admission_report, created_time, updated_time, created_user_id, updated_user_id FROM derive_plan_snapshot WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND revision = #{revision}
mapper.update: UPDATE derive_plan_snapshot SET status = 'ADMITTED', admission_report = #{reportJson}::jsonb, plan_hash = #{planHash}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND revision = #{revision} AND status = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE run SET active_plan_revision = #{revision}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{runId}
